svg.title: For the source’s dense-word approximation p to v, the latter is bounded by 2∥v −p∥+ ∥U(g)p − U(g0)p∥. This keeps the finite-label/Schwartz proof on the dense span and its extension to arbitrary vectors. Conjugating the actual domain identity (FR4) recovers covariance on DZ. Let VR identify the chamber source and define its attachment by IZ = VRIV −1 W . It remains an isometry and reads IZVW [b] = VRηb, IZUZ(a) = UZ R(a)IZ.
